title: Fill text 8 at 20 mm sews stroke by stroke as PE-DESIGN does
description: 8 in Lato Bold at 20 mm with the region switched to Fill Stitch at PE-DESIGN's text Fill defaults (density 5.0, under sewing off, Frequency 30 %, step 4.0). PE-DESIGN 11.50 sews fill lettering stroke by stroke too, rows across each stroke in its Convert to Blocks order (docs/research/stroke-lettering.md, round 5).

references.make: On a 100 × 100 mm Design Page, with Lato Bold (crates/openstitch-design/fonts/Lato-Bold.ttf, OFL) installed as a TrueType font: Text tool, type 8, size 20.0 mm, the region switched to Fill Stitch (Text tab > Sew), everything else at PE-DESIGN's text defaults (Fill: density 5.0, under sewing off, Frequency 30 %, step 4.0; line Not Sewn). Save As PES (default type).

measurements.evidence: PE-DESIGN 11.50 reference: needle points of the fill letter
